title: toddalia megapotamica
intro: Toddalia megapotamica, commonly known as the Indian plum or tawainese Indian plum, is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family of citrus and related plants. It has been traditionally used in various parts of the world, particularly in Asia, for its medicinal properties and health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of Toddalia megapotamica include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its potential health benefits, including anti-cancer and anti-diabetic effects.
